## MapboxMapProps.excludeMapFromTabOrder property

Whether to exclude the map canvas from sequential keyboard navigation. Defaults to false to preserve Mapbox's default tab order.

**Signature:**

```typescript
excludeMapFromTabOrder?: boolean;
```
